observations: STO Linen home has sale hero, worldwide-shipping copy, footwear category entry points, countdown promotion, footwear collection shelves and product cards with color cues.

Footwear collection shows 69 results, Featured sort and Product type, Color, Size, Price and Availability filter groups.
Cards display names, prices, sale/new markers and color cues; no filters, sort or cards were activated.
Teddy Heel PDP shows $620, sizes 35–43, size guide, in-stock copy, quantity stepper, Add to Bag, model-fit and materials/care copy, plus Product Care and Shipping and Returns sections.

Dedicated cart says Your cart is empty and There are no items in your cart; Continue shopping returns to footwear, with service and newsletter/footer content.

caveats: Linen homepage already had indexed HTML, so rendered home adds no unique-home credit; rendered page counts are separate.
